purpose: Teach: 凌/善悪/風刺/訳す/散乱/内需/砦/ノミネート

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、新薬、本気で、絶対、既存薬を、絶対、凌駕する、絶対、効果、本気で、進歩、しております
lines.en: Ren, the new medication is showing genuinely remarkable progress—it truly does outperform the existing treatments.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Opens with his name as direct address. Clear conviction on the comparison without overselling. Warm professional tone, the voice of someone who has seen data but still cares about the person hearing it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療の善悪、本気で、絶対、現代、絶対、難しい、絶対、議論、ですよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The ethics of medicine really are complicated in our era, aren't they, Doctor? I'm grateful for you explaining this.
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuine curiosity. Slight hesitation before the question—thinking aloud rather than performing. Soft on the gratitude at the end, not effusive. The tone of someone genuinely wrestling with an idea.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医療を、本気で、絶対、風刺、絶対、する作品、絶対、最近、増えてますね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. There's been an increase in works that critique medicine lately. It's an important conversation.
lines.style: Reflective, almost gentle. Acknowledges the trend without judgment. Pause weight on 'conversation'—she's thinking about why this matters. Steady, professorial but not distant.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 海外の医療文献、本気で、絶対、訳す、絶対、作業、医療界、絶対、進めていらっしゃいますね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The translation work on overseas medical literature—I've noticed the field is really pushing that forward now.
lines.style: Curious, engaged tone. Building momentum as he speaks about the work itself. Not quite a question but open—inviting her to confirm or expand. Genuine interest, not performance.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医療現場、本気で、絶対、書類、絶対、散乱する状況、絶対、整理、必要ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The clinical environments are drowning in paperwork. We need better systems to manage it all.
lines.style: Tired underneath but not defeated. Matter-of-fact recognition of a real problem. Light sigh in the rhythm, not audible but in the pace. Speaking from experience. Practical, not complaining.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療と内需、本気で、絶対、関係、絶対、深いですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The connection between medicine and domestic needs really runs deep, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Slower here. Ren is making a larger connection, thinking it through as he speaks. Respectful, genuinely curious about her take. Soft on 'deep'—not emphatic, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。地域医療の砦、本気で、絶対、私たち、絶対、守ってまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're committed to preserving local healthcare wherever we can. It's something I take seriously.
lines.style: Quietly firm. A promise underneath the words. Not grand, but the kind of quiet conviction that carries weight. Opens with acceptance, lands on her own stake in this. Composed, sincere.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療研究、本気で、絶対、国際賞、絶対、ノミネート、絶対、可能性、ですよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Medical research deserves international recognition. There's real possibility for that ahead, isn't there?
lines.style: Hopeful but grounded. Not starry-eyed. Building on the conversation with a slight lift in the second half—possibility entering. Respectful look toward the future, checking her wisdom on it.
